label: Candlestick pattern
name: Hammer
s1: Girawat ke baad chhoti body aur lambi neeche ki wick. Bikri ka dabav aaya par khareedaron ne bhaav wapas oopar kheencha.
s2: Aksar rukti hui girawat ka sanket maana jata hai.
s3: Agli candle se confirmation dekhte hain. Akeli hammer candle kaafi nahi.

label: Candlestick pattern
name: Bullish Engulfing
s1: Chhoti lal candle ke baad badi hari candle jo pichhli candle ko poora dhak leti hai.
s2: Khareedaron ka control wapas aane ka sanket maana jata hai.
s3: Volume zyada ho to zyada bharosemand maani jaati hai.

label: Candlestick pattern
name: Morning Star
s1: 3 candle: badi lal, chhoti body (star), phir badi hari candle.
s2: Girawat ke thakne aur palatne ka sanket maana jata hai.
s3: Ye kam banta hai, aur kabhi-kabhi fail bhi hota hai.

label: Candlestick pattern
name: Piercing Line
s1: Badi lal candle, phir hari candle neeche khulti hai aur pichhli body ke aadhe se upar band hoti hai.
s2: Girawat ke baad khareedari lautne ka halka sanket.
s3: Bullish Engulfing se kamzor maana jata hai.

label: Candlestick pattern
name: Three White Soldiers
s1: Lagatar 3 hari candles, har ek pichhli se oopar band hoti hai.
s2: Mazboot khareedari ka sanket maana jata hai.
s3: Bahut tez badhat ke baad ye thakaan ka bhi ishara ho sakta hai.

label: Candlestick pattern
name: Shooting Star
s1: Badhat ke baad chhoti body neeche aur lambi oopar ki wick. Bhaav oopar gaya par wapas gir gaya.
s2: Badhat ke kamzor hone ka sanket maana jata hai.
s3: Agli candle ka confirmation dekhna zaroori hai.

label: Candlestick pattern
name: Bearish Engulfing
s1: Chhoti hari candle ke baad badi lal candle jo use poora dhak leti hai.
s2: Bechne walon ka control aane ka sanket maana jata hai.
s3: Support ke paas banne par aksar bekaar rehta hai.

label: Candlestick pattern
name: Evening Star
s1: Badi hari, chhoti body (star), phir badi lal candle.
s2: Badhat ke thakne aur palatne ka sanket maana jata hai.
s3: Morning Star ka ulta. Ye bhi confirmation maangta hai.

label: Candlestick pattern
name: Dark Cloud Cover
s1: Badi hari candle, phir lal candle oopar khulti hai aur pichhli body ke aadhe se neeche band hoti hai.
s2: Badhat mein dabav aane ka sanket.
s3: Piercing Line ka ulta.

label: Candlestick pattern
name: Three Black Crows
s1: Lagatar 3 lal candles, har ek pichhli se neeche band hoti hai.
s2: Mazboot bikri ka sanket maana jata hai.
s3: Bahut gir chuke bhaav par ye aksar der se aata hai.

label: Candlestick pattern
name: Hanging Man
s1: Badhat ke baad Hammer jaisi shape, par oopar banti hai.
s2: Badhat ke kamzor hone ka halka sanket.
s3: Akele isse zyada matlab nikalna theek nahi.

label: Candlestick pattern
name: Doji
s1: Open aur close lagbhag barabar. Khareedar aur bechne wale barabar the.
s2: Fasla-hin (indecision) ka sanket.
s3: Ye kahan banta hai, usse matlab badalta hai.

label: Chart pattern
name: Double Bottom
s1: Bhaav do baar lagbhag same neeche level tak gir kar ubharta hai (W shape).
s2: Neckline ke upar band hone par pattern poora maana jata hai.
s3: Pattern aksar fail hote hain. Volume aur doosre sanket bhi dekho.

label: Chart pattern
name: Inverse Head & Shoulders
s1: 3 neeche ke point, beech wala sabse gehra (head).
s2: Neckline ke upar nikalna bullish maana jata hai.
s3: Pattern aksar fail hote hain. Volume aur doosre sanket bhi dekho.

label: Chart pattern
name: Cup and Handle
s1: Gol pyaale jaisa gadda, phir chhota sa dip (handle), phir oopar nikalna.
s2: Handle ke baad resistance toot-na kaafi dekha jata hai.
s3: Pattern aksar fail hote hain. Volume aur doosre sanket bhi dekho.

label: Chart pattern
name: Ascending Triangle
s1: Oopar ek samaan resistance, neeche badhte hue lows.
s2: Resistance ke upar volume ke saath nikalna bullish maana jata hai.
s3: Pattern aksar fail hote hain. Volume aur doosre sanket bhi dekho.

label: Chart pattern
name: Bull Flag
s1: Tez badhat (pole), phir halka neeche dhalta channel (flag), phir wapas badhat.
s2: Flag ke upar nikalna badhat ke jaari rehne ka sanket.
s3: Pattern aksar fail hote hain. Volume aur doosre sanket bhi dekho.

label: Chart pattern
name: Double Top
s1: Bhaav do baar lagbhag same oopar ke level se wapas aata hai (M shape).
s2: Neckline ke neeche band hone par pattern poora maana jata hai.
s3: Pattern aksar fail hote hain. Volume aur doosre sanket bhi dekho.

label: Chart pattern
name: Head & Shoulders
s1: 3 oopar ke point, beech wala sabse oonchha (head).
s2: Neckline ke neeche toot-na bearish maana jata hai.
s3: Pattern aksar fail hote hain. Volume aur doosre sanket bhi dekho.

label: Chart pattern
name: Descending Triangle
s1: Neeche ek samaan support, oopar girte hue highs.
s2: Support ke neeche toot-na bearish maana jata hai.
s3: Pattern aksar fail hote hain. Volume aur doosre sanket bhi dekho.

label: Chart pattern
name: Rising Wedge
s1: Bhaav oopar jaata hai par range sankri hoti jaati hai.
s2: Aksar neeche toot kar khatam hota hai.
s3: Pattern aksar fail hote hain. Volume aur doosre sanket bhi dekho.

label: Chart pattern
name: Bear Flag
s1: Tez girawat (pole), phir halka oopar chadhta channel, phir wapas girawat.
s2: Flag ke neeche nikalna girawat jaari rehne ka sanket.
s3: Pattern aksar fail hote hain. Volume aur doosre sanket bhi dekho.

label: Indicator
name: Moving Average (SMA / EMA)
s1: Pichhle N dino ke close ka average (EMA mein naye dino ko zyada wazan). Aam: 20, 50, 200.
s2: Bhaav average ke oopar ho aur average upar jaa raha ho to trend upar maana jata hai. 2 averages ka crossover bhi dekha jata hai.
s3: Peeche chalta hai (lagging). Sideways market mein baar-baar galat sanket deta hai.

label: Indicator
name: RSI (14)
s1: 0 se 100 ke beech ka momentum meter, pichhle 14 candles ke badhat aur girawat se.
s2: Parampara se 70 ke upar 'overbought' aur 30 ke neeche 'oversold' kehte hain. Divergence bhi dekhte hain.
s3: Mazboot trend mein RSI lambe samay tak 70 ke upar rah sakta hai. Akela bechne ya kharidne ka sanket nahi.

label: Indicator
name: MACD
s1: 12 aur 26 EMA ka antar, saath mein 9 EMA ki signal line aur histogram.
s2: MACD signal line ko paar kare to momentum badalne ka sanket maana jata hai. Zero line trend dikhati hai.
s3: Lagging hai, aur sideways market mein jhute sanket aate hain.

label: Indicator
name: Bollinger Bands
s1: 20 SMA ke oopar-neeche 2 standard deviation ke bands.
s2: Bands chaude to volatility zyada, sankre to kam (squeeze). Bhaav bands ke andar ghoomta hai.
s3: Band ko chhoo-na apne aap palatne ka sanket nahi. Trend mein bhaav band ke saath chalta reh sakta hai.

label: Indicator
name: VWAP
s1: Din ke har trade ko volume se tol kar nikala gaya average bhaav. Sirf intraday, roz naye se shuru.
s2: Bhaav VWAP ke oopar ho to us din khareedar bhaari, neeche ho to bechne wale. Bade investors ise benchmark ki tarah dekhte hain.
s3: Din ke shuru mein kam data hota hai, aur ye multi-day chart ke liye nahi hai.

label: Indicator
name: ATR (14)
s1: Average True Range: kisi candle mein bhaav ki average chaal, paise mein.
s2: Volatility naapne aur stop-loss ki doori tay karne mein madad karta hai.
s3: Ye direction nahi batata, sirf utaar-chadhav ka size.

label: Volume aur Liquidity
name: Volume
s1: Kisi din kitne shares kharide-beche gaye.
s2: Bhaav ka move zyada volume ke saath ho to zyada mazboot maana jata hai. Kam volume ka breakout aksar fail hota hai. Isse pichhle 20 din ke average volume se compare karte hain.
s3: Akele ek number ka matlab nikalna theek nahi. Poori tasveer dekho.

label: Volume aur Liquidity
name: Delivery %
s1: Volume ka wo hissa jo sach mein delivery ke liye gaya, din mein square-off nahi hua.
s2: Zyada delivery % ka matlab zyada logon ne shares apne paas rakhe. Ye NSE roz publish karta hai. Akele iska matlab nikalna theek nahi.
s3: Akele ek number ka matlab nikalna theek nahi. Poori tasveer dekho.

label: Volume aur Liquidity
name: Liquidity
s1: Kitni aasani se shares bina bhaav ko hilaye kharide-beche ja sakte hain.
s2: Bade stocks mein liquidity zyada hoti hai. Chhote stocks, SME aur penny stocks mein bid-ask ka fark bada ho sakta hai, aur apna order bhaav ko khud hila sakta hai (slippage).
s3: Akele ek number ka matlab nikalna theek nahi. Poori tasveer dekho.

label: Volume aur Liquidity
name: Bid-Ask Spread aur Market Depth
s1: Bid = sabse oonchi khareed ki bolli, Ask = sabse neeche bikri ki bolli. Depth mein dono taraf ke pending orders dikhte hain.
s2: Spread jitna chhota, liquidity utni achhi. Depth patli ho to bada order bhaav ko bahut hilaa deta hai.
s3: Akele ek number ka matlab nikalna theek nahi. Poori tasveer dekho.

label: Volume aur Liquidity
name: Traded Value
s1: Volume × bhaav, yaani rupaye mein kitna kaarobaar hua.
s2: Alag-alag bhaav ke stocks ki liquidity compare karne ke liye volume se behtar hai, kyunki sasta share aksar zyada volume dikhata hai.
s3: Akele ek number ka matlab nikalna theek nahi. Poori tasveer dekho.

label: Strategy ka concept
name: Trend Following
s1: Trend ke saath chalna: bhaav lambe moving average ke oopar ho to upar wale trade, neeche ho to neeche wale.
s2: Tay rules: kab shuru karna, stop-loss kahan, kab nikalna. Rules pehle likhte hain.
s3: Sideways market mein baar-baar chhote nuksan hote hain.

label: Strategy ka concept
name: Breakout (volume ke saath)
s1: Bhaav kisi range ya resistance se bahar nikle aur volume bhi zyada ho.
s2: Range kaise tay karte hain, aur candle ko range ke bahar band hona chahiye ya nahi, ye pehle tay karte hain.
s3: False breakout aam hain: bhaav bahar jaakar wapas aa jata hai.

label: Strategy ka concept
name: Pullback
s1: Trend mein bhaav thoda peeche hat kar support ya moving average ke paas se wapas trend ki taraf chale.
s2: Support kahan hai aur kab ye maan liya jaye ki trend khatam hua, ye pehle se tay karte hain.
s3: Pullback kab 'trend palatna' ban jaye, ye pehle se pata nahi hota.

label: Strategy ka concept
name: Support aur Resistance
s1: Wo bhaav jahan se pehle bhaav bar-bar palta hai. Range mein trade karne ke liye dekhte hain.
s2: Level kitni baar chhua gaya aur kitne volume par, ye dekhte hain.
s3: Har level aakhir mein toot sakta hai.

label: Strategy ka concept
name: Mean Reversion
s1: Bhaav average se bahut door jaaye to wapas average ki taraf aane ki umeed (RSI ya Bollinger Bands se naapte hain).
s2: Mazboot trend mein ye strategy badi galti ban sakti hai, isliye trend ka filter lagate hain.
s3: Trend mein 'sasta' aur sasta ho sakta hai.
